description: This file defines the EditFileTool class, a utility for editing files with support for diff visualization, line ending normalization, and replacement validation. It includes methods for executing file edits, handling partial requests, and tracking contributions.

classes.name: EditFileTool
classes.description: A class extending BaseTool to facilitate file editing with diff visualization, validation, and contribution tracking.

methods.name: parseLegacy
methods.description: Parses legacy parameters into structured EditFileParams.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Performs the file editing operation, including validation, diff generation, user approval, and saving changes.

methods.name: handlePartial
methods.description: Handles partial requests for file editing, typically for UI interactions.
